real_defects.issue: A line a rival priced only as a lump sum (amount, no qty) gave no unit price, so a bidder who left it out was 'unleveled', had nothing added, and could be named lowest leveled. Repro: Studs 100 + Vapor barrier 1000 sq ft, no plan prices; A bids studs 100 at 4 and vapor barrier amount 900; B bids studs 100 at 4.5 only. Before: B lowestLeveled at 450 vs A 1300. After: B leveled 1350, A lowest. Fix: median of peer lump sums prices the gap (refAmount, refSource 'median of lump-sum bids').
tolerance was used unchecked: -1 flagged every exact quantity as 'over'; NaN or a string turned all quantity checks off silently. Now refused with an error and 0.05 used.
